messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated error rate and 5xx spike observed for model redwood-lumina-1 in eu-west1 starting now. Error rate ~18% over 5m window, overall latency up ~2x. Paging oncall. root cause unknown.
Alice (oncall): on it — I'm looking at the deployment and metrics. please add any triage notes here.
Frank SRE: grabbing logs and request traces. seeing a surge in OOM-ish failures from the serving pool for lumina-1 replicas. rolling error traces now. :eyes:
Eva (ML): quick context — we rolled redwood-lumina-1:v2026-03-08 last night (lightweight tokenizer change + kv-cache tweak). No architecture changes but quantization profile updated.
Ben (Platform): if it's a quantization regression that's affecting memory, we should fallback traffic to the previous variant. Recommend temporary routing rule -> lumina-1:v2026-02-28 (previous). Suggest command below to pin globally and create fallback.
Ben (Platform): ```
# pin model to known-good version and route traffic
redwoodctl models pin --model redwood-lumina-1 --version v2026-02-28 --scope global
redwoodctl routes update --name gen-api --model redwood-lumina-1:v2026-02-28 --weight 100
```
Alice (oncall): executing fallback route now. will monitor error rate and latency after traffic shift.
Carol (Support): starting a customer impact assessment. Which customers use lumina-1 as default? pulling list from usage DB. I'll draft a status page update and a short customer note we can push if degradation persists.
Dan (Sales): flagging a couple of enterprise accounts on Dedicated who might see throttled throughput. We should prepare targeted comms in case SLA impact is expected.
Frank SRE: fallback applied at 2068004510. routing shows 100% -> v2026-02-28. errors dropping in some zones but eu-west1 still showing sporadic failures (likely stale hosts). healing nodes re-provisioning now.
Alice (oncall): current metrics: error rate down from 18% -> 4% post-fallback, p95 latency trending back to expected. Keeping monitoring for 30m.
Eva (ML): quick post-mortem note: the quant profile update reduced activation memory by ~8% in our tests but introduced occasional kernel fallback paths on A100 drivers that trigger higher memory churn. Reverting to previous quant profile for lumina-1 on that variant is safest. I'll prepare a patch.
Ben (Platform): Ops note: we should add an automatic safety check to compare memory usage vs test baseline after model rollout. Filing ticket INF-4987.
Carol (Support): Draft status page update (please edit):
```
component: Model Generation (redwood-lumina-1)
status: degraded
summary: We observed elevated error rates for requests using redwood-lumina-1. Traffic has been routed to a previous model variant; most customers are back to normal. Engineers continue to investigate residual errors in eu-west1. Next update in 30m or when resolved.
```
Dan (Sales): Draft customer notification for enterprise customers (short):
"We're investigating increased error rates affecting the redwood-lumina-1 model in eu-west1. We've routed traffic to a stable variant and expect normal service to resume shortly. If you see persistent issues, please reply and we'll prioritize your tenant."
Alice (oncall): Can someone from ML own the rollback patch PR so we can keep the pinned version until patch lands? I don't want to unpin mid-investigation.
Eva (ML): I'll open PR #2345 with the quant profile revert and a short test matrix. ETA 2h. We'll keep the pin until QA approves.
Frank SRE: leaving a small mitigation checklist here for handoff: 1) monitor error rate for 1h 2) ensure fallback remains pinned 3) run retires on eu-west1 faulty hosts 4) prepare rollout plan for patched quant profile.
Carol (Support): copying the drafted status page update to status.redwood.ai and setting incident visibility to "degraded". Notifying top 10 active customers by DM.
Dan (Sales): I'll send the enterprise note to the listed accounts with the short blurb, cc support and oncall.
Alice (oncall): thanks everyone. I'm going to start 30m watch rotation and will hand off at +30m to Frank if still active. leaving note for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Frank SRE: taking 30m watch if still needed. Logging this thread to the incident timeline. We'll escalate to incident commander if errors climb above 10% again.
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2068004321. Current status: degraded -> mitigation applied (traffic pinned). Updates will be appended to the incident timeline.
Carol (Support): Final note for this thread (for now) — customer comm template and status page are live. We'll update customers if anything changes.
Alice (oncall): closing active paging for now; monitoring only. will file postmortem with timeline and RCA.
